vaultDoctor.label: Vault Doctor
vaultDoctor.description: Scan the vault for metadata issues, sync conflicts, and safe repairs.

decisions.choose: Choose one file to keep this id. The other {{count}} will get new unique ids.

NOTES_LEGACY_ASSET.message: {{assetName}} is still stored in the legacy Notes assets folder.
NOTES_LEGACY_ASSET.recommendation: Keep the whole vault synchronized and scan again after migration completes.

NOTES_ASSET_MIGRATION_PENDING.message: {{assetName}} is not available locally for migration inspection.
NOTES_ASSET_MIGRATION_PENDING.recommendation: Make the asset available locally, then scan the vault again.

NOTES_ASSET_DESTINATION_CONFLICT.message: {{assetName}} differs between the legacy and current Notes assets folders.
NOTES_ASSET_DESTINATION_CONFLICT.recommendation: Compare both files and keep the correct copy before removing either one.

NOTES_ASSET_MISSING.message: {{assetName}} is missing from both Notes assets folders.
NOTES_ASSET_MISSING.recommendation: Restore the asset to the vault or remove its reference from the note.

tabSize.label: Tab Size

highlightLine.label: Highlight Line
highlightLine.description: Visual highlight on the line where the cursor is positioned.

matchBrackets.label: Match Brackets
matchBrackets.description: Matching bracket highlighting near the cursor.

trailingComma.label: Trailing Comma
trailingComma.description: Trailing commas in multi-line structures when formatting.

semi.label: Semi
semi.description: Semicolons at the end of every statement.

singleQuote.label: Single Quote
singleQuote.description: Single quotes instead of double quotes.

fontSize.label: Font Size
fontSize.description: Base font size in pixels for the notes editor.

fontFamily.label: Text Font
fontFamily.description: Text font for the notes editor. Use commas for fallbacks.

codeFontFamily.label: Monospace Font
codeFontFamily.description: Monospace font for inline code and code blocks in the notes editor. Use commas for fallbacks.

lineHeight.label: Line Height
lineHeight.description: Spacing between lines. Relaxed is easier to read, compact fits more content.

indentSize.label: Indent Size
indentSize.description: Number of spaces per indent level for lists and nested content.

limitWidth.label: Limit Width
limitWidth.description: Maximum content width for comfortable reading (700px).

wrapTables.label: Wrap Table Cells
wrapTables.description: Wrap text in table cells to keep wide tables within the editor. Narrow tables keep their natural width.

lineNumbers.label: Line Numbers
lineNumbers.description: Line numbers in the gutter. Only available in Raw mode.

dockBadge.label: Dock Icon Counter
dockBadge.permissionDenied: macOS blocked the Dock counter. Allow notifications and badges for massCode in System Settings. Unsigned development builds may not support Dock badges.

theme.label: Theme
theme.templateCreated: Theme template created. Open the JSON file in the themes directory and edit it.
theme.dirDescription: Directory for custom JSON theme files.

dateFormat.label: Date Format
dateFormat.description: How dates are displayed in results.

cryptoRates.label: Crypto Rates
cryptoRates.description: Cached for 1 hour. Rate limit: 10-30 req/min.
cryptoRates.rateLimited: Rate limit exceeded. Try again later.

autoCleanup.label: Auto-clean completed
autoCleanup.description: Move completed tasks to trash on a schedule. They stay in trash until you empty it.

cleanupNow.label: Clean up now
cleanupNow.description: Move all completed tasks to trash right now.

history.label: History entries per request
history.description: Keep 10–100 executions per request. Lowering the limit trims older entries on the next history load or send. Disabling stops new entries and keeps existing history.

wrapLines.label: Wrap Lines
wrapLines.description: Wrap long lines in HTTP preview, request body, and response viewers.

defaultPreviewFormat.label: Default Preview Format
defaultPreviewFormat.description: Format selected by default in the request preview panel.

autoSwitchToResponse.label: Show Response After Send
autoSwitchToResponse.description: Switch the bottom panel to Response when a request starts or finishes.

sslCertificateVerification.label: SSL Certificate Verification
sslCertificateVerification.description: Verify SSL certificates when sending HTTPS requests. Turn off to allow invalid or self-signed certificates.

transport.label: Transport
transport.timeoutMsHint: Set how long a request should wait for a response before timing out. To never time out, set to 0.
transport.maxResponseBytesHint: Set the maximum size of a response to download. To download a response of any size, set to 0.
transport.maxRedirectsHint: Set the maximum number of redirects to follow. To prevent redirects, set to 0.
transport.followRedirectsHint: Follow redirects automatically. By default, this is off for requests with scripts and GraphQL.
transport.skipCertificateVerificationHint: Allow requests to servers with invalid or self-signed SSL certificates.
transport.invalid: Value not applied. Enter a valid non-negative number. Timeout and redirects must be whole numbers; redirects cannot exceed 100.
transport.protocolVersionHint: Choose the HTTP version. Auto negotiates HTTP/2 over HTTPS with HTTP/1.1 fallback. HTTP/2 requires HTTPS and server support. Default: HTTP/1.1.
transport.encodeUrlHint: Encode spaces and special characters in the URL. When off, enter an already encoded URL and query parameters. Default: on.
transport.followOriginalHttpMethodHint: Keep the method and body when following redirects. When off, use GET after POST 301/302 and non-HEAD 303. Default: switch to GET only on 303.
transport.followAuthorizationHeaderHint: Forward Authorization when a redirect points to another origin. Enable only for trusted destinations. Default: off.
transport.removeRefererHeaderOnRedirectHint: Remove the Referer header when following redirects. Default: off.
transport.HTTP2_NOT_NEGOTIATED: The server did not negotiate HTTP/2. Choose Auto or HTTP/1.1.
transport.HTTP_URL_ENCODING_REQUIRED: URL encoding is off. Enter an already encoded URL and query parameters, or enable automatic encoding.
transport.HTTP_REDIRECT_PROTOCOL: The redirect URL must use HTTP or HTTPS.

port.label: API Port
port.description: Port number for the API server (requires app restart to take effect). Valid range: 1024-65535.

enabled.label: Enable API integrations
enabled.description: Allow external local clients to use protected integration endpoints.

token.label: API token
token.description: Use this token in external clients. The full token is shown only after generation.

status.label: Status
status.description: Thank you for supporting massCode! Donation prompts are turned off.

key.label: License key
key.description: Paste the key you received after donating. Activation works offline and removes donation prompts.

request.label: No key yet?
request.description: If you have ever donated to massCode through any channel, send any proof of donation by email and you will receive a key.

autoUpdate.label: Automatic updates
autoUpdate.description: Download updates in the background and install them on restart. When disabled, massCode only notifies you about new versions. Major versions are never installed automatically.
